blocks.text: How do you create a presentation?

blocks.md:
- In the exam, **content for the presentation** is provided in a **rich text format** (.rtf)
- The content **can be imported** using the '**new slide**' button on the **home tab **and selecting '**Slides from Outline**'

blocks.alt: PowerPoint window showing a blank presentation slide template with "Click to add title" and "Click to add subtitle" text, menu options visible above.
blocks.caption: Creating a presentation from a text file

blocks.md:
- A master slide allows you to** control the design and layout** of an entire presentation **from one place**
- A master slide controls:

  - **Colours**
  - **Fonts**
  - **Headers & footers**
  - **Positioning of objects**

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md: Remember to make sure you scroll to the top of the master slide window and select the first slide!

- Select the master slide
- Insert a text box
- From the '**insert**' tab, select '**Slide Number**'
- Close the master slide

blocks.alt: PowerPoint slide titled "Base Metal Mining" with one bullet point reading "Around the world." Slide thumbnails for additional content are visible on the left.
blocks.caption: Adding auto numbering to slides

blocks.md:
- Select the master slide
- From the 'insert' tab, choose an object
- Position on the slide
- Close the master slide

blocks.alt: PowerPoint presentation editing mode with "Base Metal Mining" slide highlighted. Slide shows title "Base Metal Mining" and bullet point "Around the world".
blocks.caption: Adding objects to slides

blocks.md:
- Select the master slide
- Make desired changes (font & paragraph)
- Close master slide

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md: If your changes **are not visible** after closing the master slide, highlight the text and use the '**Clear All Formatting**' button (see below)

blocks.alt: PowerPoint slide displaying the title "Base Metal Mining" with a bullet point listing "Around the world." Four slide thumbnails are visible on the left panel.
blocks.caption: Formatting the master slide
